name: mba-mcp
description: Run your MBA recruiting campaign from inside Claude: target firms, live job boards, deadlines, warm intros and approved outreach.
long_description:
MBA recruiting is won on timelines and relationships, not application volume. This adds a campaign layer to Claude: a target-firm list that resolves each firm's live job board, an application pipeline with cycle-aware deadlines for consulting and investment banking, warm paths ranked from your own LinkedIn export, LinkedIn alumni searches you run yourself, and cold emails Claude drafts and you approve before a single message is sent from your own Gmail.

Everything stays on your computer. No account, no subscription, no model API key, and no scraping of anyone's LinkedIn.
